responsibility: Implements MIR-based compile-time function evaluation for constants and statics, combining the CTFE machine and its execution rules, the query entry points that run MIR and intern/convert results, the predicates that decide which functions and impl items may be called in const contexts, and the error machinery that turns interpreter failures into diagnostics. The module entry point ties these pieces together and exposes higher-level helpers built on evaluated constants, such as caller-location construction, valtree conversion, constant destructuring, printing support, and safe dereferencing of immutable constant references.
